text:
alex: FYI I pushed the follow-up patch that addresses the review comments from yesterday. PTAL when you have a minute: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/492

ruchi: Thanks — skimmed. Two tiny nits in the README and one question about the fallback policy config. Can you inline the default values in the comment?

alex: Yep, done. I added a short comment and a tiny README example. Also added a smoke script: `scripts/smoke_canary.sh` — runs the basic routing + kv-cache check.

ben: quick look now. running smoke locally.

ci-bot: tests/units passed (14m), integration tests queued.

olga: main question — we have infra maintenance Monday 02:00-05:00 UTC. Do we want to hold merge until after that window? This change touches routing fallback which might interact with the rolling update.

alex: Good catch. The change is low-risk but does touch the policy selection table. My preference: merge now and schedule canary tomorrow midday; fallback ready to rollback automatically. But if we prefer more caution we can wait until maintenance is done.

ruchi: If it's low-risk and CI passes, I'm fine with canary after the maintenance window. That avoids potential overlap. Can we schedule the canary at 08:00 UTC?

ben: LGTM from me after CI green and a squash commit. One minor ask: update the changelog line to mention 'fallback routing guardrails'.

alex: Will squash + update changelog. CI integration tests are still running, ETA ~10m.

ci-bot: integration tests passed (22m).

olga: OK — let's plan merge after maintenance. alex, can you add a short blurb in the release notes and schedule canary at 08:00 UTC? I'll coordinate on-call.

alex: done — added changelog + release note. I put canary job on the calendar for 08:00 UTC under "redwood/canaries".

ruchi: +1 from me, thanks.

ben: approving now. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all — I'll hold the merge until maintenance completes and then merge & kick the canary at 08:00. PTAL any last-second objections.

olga: No objections. :white_check_mark:

alex: Merged (after window). Canary started, logs are clean so far. If anyone sees anomalous latency spike please ping #incidents.

ben: seeing normal numbers in the dashboard. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: canary/1234 completed successfully. metrics OK.

alex: closing thread — thanks for the quick reviews.
